spec.description: Every Starlink satellite where it is now, computed in DuckDB from its orbital elements: a Kepler orbit with the Earth's J2 drift, within tens of kilometres of SGP4. How many are overhead a chosen point, by shell and by launch year. Data: CelesTrak, updated every two hours.

spec.rawSql:
-- CelesTrak's mean elements, moved along a Kepler orbit with J2's secular drift
-- of the node, perigee and mean anomaly: within tens of km of SGP4 near epoch.
WITH el AS (
  SELECT OBJECT_NAME AS name, NORAD_CAT_ID AS norad, OBJECT_ID AS cospar,
         EPOCH::TIMESTAMPTZ AS epoch, MEAN_MOTION AS mm, ECCENTRICITY AS e,
         radians(INCLINATION) AS i, radians(RA_OF_ASC_NODE) AS raan0,
         radians(ARG_OF_PERICENTER) AS w0, radians(MEAN_ANOMALY) AS m0, MEAN_MOTION_DOT AS ndot,
         pow(398600.4418 / pow(MEAN_MOTION * 2 * pi() / 86400, 2), 1 / 3) AS a
  FROM read_csv('http://feeds/celestrak/starlink.csv')
),
t AS (SELECT now() AS time),
p AS (
  SELECT name, norad, cospar, time, a, e, i,
         mm * 2 * pi() / 86400 AS n,
         1.5 * 0.00108263 * pow(6378.137 / (a * (1 - e * e)), 2) * (mm * 2 * pi() / 86400) AS f,
         epoch(time) - epoch(epoch) AS dt, raan0, w0, m0, ndot
  FROM el, t
),
q AS (
  SELECT *, raan0 - f * cos(i) * dt AS raan,
            w0 + f * (2 - 2.5 * pow(sin(i), 2)) * dt AS w,
            m0 + (n + f * sqrt(1 - e * e) * (1 - 1.5 * pow(sin(i), 2))) * dt
               + 2 * pi() * ndot * pow(dt / 86400, 2) AS m,
            radians(280.46061837 + 360.98564736629 * (epoch(time) - 946728000) / 86400) AS gmst
  FROM p
),
o AS (SELECT *, m + e * sin(m) + 0.5 * e * e * sin(2 * m) AS ea FROM q),
x AS (
  SELECT *, a * (1 - e * cos(ea)) AS r,
            w + 2 * atan2(sqrt(1 + e) * sin(ea / 2), sqrt(1 - e) * cos(ea / 2)) AS u
  FROM o
),
c AS (
  SELECT *, r * (cos(raan) * cos(u) - sin(raan) * sin(u) * cos(i)) AS cx,
            r * (sin(raan) * cos(u) + cos(raan) * sin(u) * cos(i)) AS cy,
            r * sin(u) * sin(i) AS cz
  FROM x
),
pos AS (
  SELECT name, norad, cospar, time,
         degrees(atan2(cz, sqrt(cx * cx + cy * cy))) AS latitude,
         ((degrees(atan2(cy, cx) - gmst) % 360 + 540) % 360) - 180 AS longitude,
         round(r - 6378.137)::INTEGER AS altitude_km, round(degrees(i), 1) AS inclination,
         CASE WHEN degrees(i) > 90 THEN 'Polar (97°)' WHEN degrees(i) > 60 THEN '70°'
              WHEN degrees(i) > 50 THEN '53°' WHEN degrees(i) > 40 THEN '43°' ELSE '33°' END AS shell
  FROM c
)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE altitude_km > 150) AS "In orbit",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE altitude_km BETWEEN 340 AND 600) AS "At operational height",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE altitude_km BETWEEN 150 AND 340) AS "Raising or reentering"
FROM pos

spec.description: Satellites in CelesTrak's Starlink group, propagated to now. Operational shells sit between about 340 and 600 km; lower ones are climbing after launch or coming down.

-- Above 25° of elevation from the point: for Starlink heights, within about 900 km on the ground.
SELECT count(*) AS "Overhead now"
FROM pos, obs
WHERE altitude_km > 150
  AND 6371 * acos(least(1, sin(radians(olat)) * sin(radians(latitude))
      + cos(radians(olat)) * cos(radians(latitude)) * cos(radians(longitude - olon)))) < 900

-- CelesTrak's mean elements, moved along a Kepler orbit with J2's secular drift
-- of the node, perigee and mean anomaly: within tens of km of SGP4 near epoch.
WITH el AS (
  SELECT OBJECT_NAME AS name, NORAD_CAT_ID AS norad, OBJECT_ID AS cospar,
         EPOCH::TIMESTAMPTZ AS epoch, MEAN_MOTION AS mm, ECCENTRICITY AS e,
         radians(INCLINATION) AS i, radians(RA_OF_ASC_NODE) AS raan0,
         radians(ARG_OF_PERICENTER) AS w0, radians(MEAN_ANOMALY) AS m0, MEAN_MOTION_DOT AS ndot,
         pow(398600.4418 / pow(MEAN_MOTION * 2 * pi() / 86400, 2), 1 / 3) AS a
  FROM read_csv('http://feeds/celestrak/starlink.csv')
),
t AS (SELECT unnest(generate_series(date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ), $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ,
         greatest(INTERVAL 1 MINUTE, date_trunc('minute', ($__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ - $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ) / 8)))) AS time),
p AS (
  SELECT name, norad, cospar, time, a, e, i,
         mm * 2 * pi() / 86400 AS n,
         1.5 * 0.00108263 * pow(6378.137 / (a * (1 - e * e)), 2) * (mm * 2 * pi() / 86400) AS f,
         epoch(time) - epoch(epoch) AS dt, raan0, w0, m0, ndot
  FROM el, t
),
q AS (
  SELECT *, raan0 - f * cos(i) * dt AS raan,
            w0 + f * (2 - 2.5 * pow(sin(i), 2)) * dt AS w,
            m0 + (n + f * sqrt(1 - e * e) * (1 - 1.5 * pow(sin(i), 2))) * dt
               + 2 * pi() * ndot * pow(dt / 86400, 2) AS m,
            radians(280.46061837 + 360.98564736629 * (epoch(time) - 946728000) / 86400) AS gmst
  FROM p
),
o AS (SELECT *, m + e * sin(m) + 0.5 * e * e * sin(2 * m) AS ea FROM q),
x AS (
  SELECT *, a * (1 - e * cos(ea)) AS r,
            w + 2 * atan2(sqrt(1 + e) * sin(ea / 2), sqrt(1 - e) * cos(ea / 2)) AS u
  FROM o
),
c AS (
  SELECT *, r * (cos(raan) * cos(u) - sin(raan) * sin(u) * cos(i)) AS cx,
            r * (sin(raan) * cos(u) + cos(raan) * sin(u) * cos(i)) AS cy,
            r * sin(u) * sin(i) AS cz
  FROM x
),
pos AS (
  SELECT name, norad, cospar, time,
         degrees(atan2(cz, sqrt(cx * cx + cy * cy))) AS latitude,
         ((degrees(atan2(cy, cx) - gmst) % 360 + 540) % 360) - 180 AS longitude,
         round(r - 6378.137)::INTEGER AS altitude_km, round(degrees(i), 1) AS inclination,
         CASE WHEN degrees(i) > 90 THEN 'Polar (97°)' WHEN degrees(i) > 60 THEN '70°'
              WHEN degrees(i) > 50 THEN '53°' WHEN degrees(i) > 40 THEN '43°' ELSE '33°' END AS shell
  FROM c
)
,
-- Longitudes made continuous along each track, so a trail across the antimeridian
-- does not span the map, then shifted by whole turns so the newest point is in [-180, 180].
un AS (
  SELECT *, longitude + 360 * sum(CASE WHEN jump > 180 THEN -1 WHEN jump < -180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                               OVER (PARTITION BY norad ORDER BY time) AS lon_c
  FROM (SELECT *, longitude - lag(longitude, 1, longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY norad ORDER BY time) AS jump
        FROM pos WHERE altitude_km > 150)
)
SELECT norad::VARCHAR AS norad, name, shell, time, latitude,
       lon_c - 360 * round(last(lon_c) OVER (PARTITION BY norad ORDER BY time
                           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) / 360) AS longitude,
       altitude_km
FROM un
ORDER BY norad, time
